title: Myles Garrett returns with a vengeance, erupts for 3 sacks in Rams’ Week 9 win

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Myles Garrett returns with a vengeance, erupts for 3 sacks in Rams’ Week 9 win
sources.description: That's the version of Myles Garrett the Rams traded for. The reigning NFL Defensive Player of the Year returned after a seven game absence in Week 9.
